SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF JUL-02-2021 - TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF JUL-02-2021 BY MICHELLE TONG. PLAINTIFF JORGE LUIS CUEVAS CASILLAS IS PRESENT ASSISTED BY NON-CERTIFIED SPANISH INTERPRETER BELEN CUEVAS. DEFENDANT RECOLOGY IS NOT PRESENT. DEFENDANT VENN APARTMENTS IS PRESENT REPRESENTED BY SALVADOR BENITEZ, COMMUNITY MANAGER, AND REPRESENTED BY ANGELA ISAACS, REGIONAL MANAGER . THE SPANISH INTERPRETER WAS GIVEN THE INTERPRETER'S OATH BY THE COURTROOM CLERK. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE: MICHELLE TONG; CLERK: R.SAHATJIAN. NOT REPORTED.(D506)
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF JUL-02-2021 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF CASILLAS, JORGE LUIS CUEVAS RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT RECOLOGY VENN APARTMENTS $6,000.00 PRINCIPAL, $105.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $6,105.00, JOINT AND SEVERAL LIABILITY BETWEEN BOTH DEFENDANTS. COSTS INCLUDE AUTOBODY REPAIRS AND CAR RENTAL DURING THE TIME OF REPAIR. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS NO EXHIBITS FILED
